messages:
maria_marketing: Heads-up: plan to ship "Optimize v1.3" announcement on Tuesday 03/09 at 10:00 PT. Need final changelog, canonical docs links, and confirmed canary window to lock blog + newsletter + webinar invite.

noah_eng: On the changelog now, will post final bullets by EOD tomorrow. Proposal: staged rollout (5% -> 25% -> full) to avoid demo disruptions.

maria_marketing: Staged works. Recommended timing: 5% for 2h, 25% next 4h, full at +24h. That gives us breathing room for live demos.

noah_eng: We'll implement an automatic fallback to the compact model variant in routing policy. Also adding rollback thresholds (95th latency + error rate).

priya_docs: I can draft the release doc and a short quantization guide. Please send final changelog lines and the anonymized rollout YAML snippet to include in docs.

noah_eng: Draft changelog (WIP):
- Optimized batching heuristics to reduce tail latency for short prompts
- Fix for prefix KV cache invalidation across multi-tenant pools
- Introduced q4_legacy quantization profile: ~20% memory reduction with small quality delta
- Canary routing with automatic fallback to smaller-context model variant

maria_marketing: Good. Priya, please alias the links as /docs/release/optimize-1-3 and /docs/guides/quantization so marketing can reference stable URLs.

priya_docs: Will do. ETA: docs pages live tomorrow 12:00 PT. I'll include a code block with an anonymized rollout example and a troubleshooting/rollback section.

sam_product: Add a short explainer about q4_legacy: recommended for low-latency chat and high-concurrency inference; include suggested eval prompts.

lena_design: I'll prepare hero image + social tiles. Avoid numeric latency claims in copy.

maria_marketing: Correct — avoid absolute latency numbers. Use relative phrasing: "~20% memory reduction" and "15–25% fewer tail spikes in internal chat benchmarks." We'll reference the internal benchmark deck.

noah_eng: Deployment checklist: canary at 10:00 PT, health check windows every 15m. Auto-rollback if 95th latency >15% vs baseline or error rate >0.5%. release-bot will post updates to #release-war-room.

release-bot: Canary scheduled at 1769690000 (10:00 PT). Will ping at stage boundaries.

priya_docs: Quick Q on YAML: should we show autoscale fields? Those contain customer-specific numbers.

sam_product: No, use placeholders for capacity values. Show pattern only.

maria_marketing: Timeline recap: tomorrow EOD — final changelog. Tomorrow 12:00 PT — docs live. Monday AM — design assets. Tuesday 10:00 PT — announce + canary. Wednesday — webinar invite to opt-ins with demo link.

noah_eng: Confirmed. I'll post the final changelog here when done and include rollback thresholds for the appendix.

priya_docs: Will drop doc URLs here as soon as they’re live.

lena_design: Assets uploaded to the marketing drive by Monday AM; will post links here.

maria_marketing: Thanks all — flag blockers here. :thumbsup:

noah_eng: Small note: include customer opt-out instructions for pinned model versions in the announcement appendix.

maria_marketing: Will add opt-out instructions and the rollback appendix to the blog draft.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: 1769690355 — pre-launch checklist ping to this channel.
